_published_faq.name: How do I add IBI SMART to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add IBI SMART to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://smartapi.ibi.co.il/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the IBI SMART MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: IBI SMART provides these MCP tools: get_account_portfolio.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to IBI SMART?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to IBI SMART in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does IBI SMART MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: IBI SMART requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
IBI SMART is developed by IBI SMART. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
